---
title: "Glossary"
subtitle: "Every key term from the study units, in alphabetical order."
toc: false
---

```{r}
source("R/helpers.R")
units <- load_units()
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
terms <- purrr::map(units, \(u) purrr::map(u$terms, \(t) tibble::tibble(
  term = t$term, definition = t$definition, unit = u$number, unit_id = u$id, unit_title = u$title
)) |> purrr::list_rbind()) |>
  purrr::list_rbind() |>
  dplyr::arrange(tolower(term))

for (k in seq_len(nrow(terms))) {
  t <- terms[k, ]
  cat("**", t$term, "**\n", sep = "")
  cat(":   ", t$definition, " *From [Unit ", t$unit, ": ", t$unit_title, "](units/", t$unit_id, ".qmd).*\n\n", sep = "")
}
```
